method: Playwright + Chromium, two independent browser contexts (customer + owner/admin), live orders placed and completed
note: The live deployment predates fixes made in the working tree during this session. BUG-003 is already fixed locally and awaits deploy.

bugs.title: A new order never reaches an owner already looking at the Orders screen
steps: Owner signs in and parks on /owner/<slug>/orders
In a separate browser context, a customer places an order from /shop/<slug>
Do not touch the owner screen; sample it every 5s for 2 minutes
bugs.expected: Order appears, or the waiting count / bell increments, with no manual refresh
bugs.actual: Nothing changes for 120s. Manual reload shows it at once. No polling, SSE or websocket exists in the owner app
bugs.impact: During a rush the owner believes there are no new orders. Push is the only alert, and push is unreliable on the target handsets
bugs.fix: Visibility-gated poll of the orders route every 15-20s, plus the chime the copy already promises

bugs.title: No READY state, and no way to tell the customer their order is ready
steps: Place an order as a customer
As owner, enumerate every control on that order
Look for a READY action and a WhatsApp message addressed to that customer
bugs.expected: NEW → PREPARING → READY → WhatsApp the customer → PAYMENT CONFIRMED → COMPLETED
bugs.actual: Statuses are NEW / CONFIRMED (Preparing) / COMPLETED / CANCELLED. Orders arrive already CONFIRMED. Controls are only Change amounts, Mark done, Cancel order. Customer-addressed WhatsApp exists only for a cut-down order and for cancellation; the other WhatsApp link is a delivery-round list with no recipient
bugs.impact: The customer is never told the order is ready — the most important message in a pickup shop. Ready and handed-over-and-paid are collapsed into one action
bugs.fix: Add READY between CONFIRMED and COMPLETED with a per-order 'Ready — tell the customer' button building wa.me/<customerPhone> plus a customer push (that plumbing already exists)

bugs.title: Pricing page and reports say orders arrive on WhatsApp
steps: Open /pricing
Read the Basic feature list, the comparison table and step 4 of How it works
bugs.expected: Copy describes QR ordering, an order queue in the app, push notification, and WhatsApp only for telling the customer
bugs.actual: 'Unlimited orders on WhatsApp'; 'Orders on WhatsApp, unlimited'; 'the order arrives on your WhatsApp'; reports label the channel 'WhatsApp orders'
bugs.impact: New owners watch the wrong screen and conclude the app lost an order
bugs.status: FIXED IN WORKING TREE (lib/plans.ts, app/pricing/page.tsx, app/admin/reports/page.tsx, lib/report-csv.ts, lib/owner-i18n.ts, README.md) — awaiting deploy

bugs.title: A rejected item save gives the admin no feedback at all
steps: Open the items page and click 'Type instead'
Name 'QA Zero', Price '0', Unit '1 kg', click Save item
Sample the page every 250ms for 4s
Repeat with -10, abc and 99999999
bugs.expected: The server's own message is shown on the price field or as a toast
bugs.actual: The API returns 422 with the exact message ('Price must be at least 50 paise' / 'Price looks too large') and the UI shows nothing: no toast, no field error, no aria-invalid
bugs.impact: Adding items is the first thing every owner does; a typo'd price produces a dead button with no explanation
bugs.fix: Read payload.errors from the 422 and set the field error (the Input component already renders `error`); fall back to a toast with payload.error

bugs.title: html lang is always 'en' on pages rendered in Bengali or Hindi
steps: Open /shop/<slug> (defaults to Bengali)
Inspect document.documentElement.lang
bugs.actual: Always 'en' while the visible text is Bengali
bugs.impact: Screen readers pronounce Bengali with an English voice — unusable for exactly the low-literacy users voice ordering targets
bugs.fix: Set lang from the active locale

bugs.title: The 404 page tells admins and owners their 'shop link may be wrong'
steps: Signed in as admin, open /admin/shops
As owner, open /owner/<slug>/items
bugs.expected: A context-appropriate 404, or a redirect to /admin and /owner/<slug>/inventory
bugs.actual: The customer-facing 404: 'This shop link may be wrong or the shop is no longer listed'
bugs.impact: Confusing; both URLs are guessable from the UI's own words ('Shops', 'Items')
bugs.fix: Route-group not-found pages, or redirects for these two URLs

bugs.title: A completed, paid order still tells the customer it is 'on its way'
steps: Complete an order as the owner (Mark done → Cash)
Open the customer's track link
bugs.expected: A final state — completed / handed over / thank you
bugs.actual: 'Ready and on its way to you.' for a COMPLETED and paid order
bugs.fix: Add a COMPLETED string for the customer; keep 'on its way' for the ready state

bugs.title: Emoji silently dropped from item names
steps: Add an item named 'চিনি 🍬'
View the storefront
bugs.expected: Saved as typed, or a message saying what was removed
bugs.actual: Saved as 'চিনি'; the emoji is stripped with no message
bugs.fix: Either keep the emoji or say it was removed

bugs.title: Sub-32px tap targets on the storefront
bugs.expected: 24px minimum (WCAG 2.5.8); 44px is the practical phone target
bugs.actual: 5 controls under 32px on /shop (language pills and similar), 1 on /pricing

bugs.title: Top plan is named 'EX'; item limits below the benchmark
bugs.actual: Plans are Basic ₹99/25, Starter ₹149/100, Pro ₹249/250, EX ₹449/1000. Annual arithmetic is correct on all four
bugs.impact: 'EX' means nothing to a shopkeeper; Pro adds little over Starter
bugs.fix: Rename EX → Business; consider 50/150/500/2000 limits and a concrete Pro-only feature

bugs.title: Super Admin credentials are admin / admin on a public URL
bugs.actual: admin/admin authenticates on the live host and fronts every shop, customer phone number and khata balance. Rate limiting (8/10min) slows brute force but not a guessed pair
bugs.fix: Rotate the password now; add a second factor for the Super Admin before any real shop is onboarded

blocked.area: Web push delivery end to end
blocked.reason: Headless Chromium reports Notification.permission='denied' even with the permission granted to the context; no PushManager subscription is created. Service worker registration, the Turn on control and the permission-blocked message were all verified
blocked.toUnblock: A real Chrome (headed) or a real Android device with notifications allowed, plus a second device to place the order

blocked.area: Voice ordering and voice item entry
blocked.reason: SpeechRecognition exists in headless Chromium but there is no audio pipeline or speech service; clicking the mic produced no recognition and no error within 8s
blocked.toUnblock: Headed real Chrome with a microphone, or a synthesised WAV fed in as a fake capture device
Install the other Playwright browsers / use the installed Chrome and Edge channels

blocked.reason: Almost certainly intended (owner picks the helper) but unconfirmed

blocked.reason: Not exercised: simulating a dropped connection against production risked half-created orders on a live shop
